editorial:
Imagine being a total coward who just got sentenced to prison for a scam. That is exactly where you find Stan, a guy who is terrified of everything, especially the tough guys he is about to live with. To survive, he spends his last bit of money on a weird martial arts teacher who promises to turn him into a fighting machine in just a few weeks. The vibe is totally silly and over-the-top, making it a great pick if you just want to turn your brain off and laugh at some goofy situations.

What really makes this work is how ridiculous the training scenes are. While the plot is simple, the physical comedy keeps things moving quickly. You will probably find some parts too cheesy, but that is part of the charm. If you love slapstick humor, you should definitely give this a try. It looks great streaming in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality. Renting it on Apple TV is also a quick and easy way to see if you like it.
endingExplained: At the end, Stan uses his new skills to defeat the biggest bullies in the prison. He proves he is no longer a coward by winning a massive fight and earning the respect of the other inmates. The twist is that his training actually worked, and he becomes the top dog in the yard. Everything wraps up with Stan feeling confident and safe, showing that his hard work with the guru paid off.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves slapstick humor and underdog stories.
